personal.name: Ayush Trivedi
personal.bio: Passionate Mechanical Engineer with hands-on experience in CAD design, FEA simulation, robotics development, and manufacturing. Proficient in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, ABAQUS, and MATLAB, with projects spanning autonomous systems, smart devices, and robotic platforms. Currently exploring autonomous robotics, advanced simulation, and AI-driven mechanical systems.

certifications.title: CAM and Design Manufacturing with Fusion 360
MATLAB Programming for Engineers and Scientists
Raspberry Pi Platform and Python Programming

description: Designed, tested, and developed an autonomous self-balancing bot targeting Industry 4.0 applications.
Implemented image processing pipelines and ran simulations on CoppeliaSim.
Deployed and tested the system on Linux environment.
Participated in SIH 2023 as team member on an IoT-based problem statement.
Designed the product enclosure using CAD software.
Integrated circuit design for amalgamating multiple IoT devices.
Led and contributed to robotics development projects for nationwide competitions.
Developed structured lessons to strengthen conceptual understanding in robotics.
Achieved top positions at inter-college robotics events.

projects.title: Autonomous Agriculture Drone
projects.description: Designed and developed an autonomous drone system for precision agriculture — path planning, obstacle avoidance, and crop health monitoring using image processing.

projects.title: Self-Balancing Robot
projects.description: Autonomous self-balancing bot implementing PID control, image processing, and CoppeliaSim simulation, targeting Industry 4.0 applications. Developed for E-Yantra 2024.

projects.title: Comparative Static Structural Analysis of Truss Bridges
projects.description: FEA-based structural analysis comparing multiple truss bridge configurations under static loading. Stress distribution, deformation patterns, and factor of safety analyzed using ABAQUS.

projects.title: Modal Frequency Analysis of Composite Shell
projects.description: Modal analysis of composite shell structures under various boundary conditions. Identified natural frequencies and mode shapes to validate theoretical models.

projects.title: Smart Autonomous Street Light System
projects.description: IoT-based street lighting system with motion detection and adaptive brightness control. Reduces energy consumption by 60% compared to conventional systems.
